lead.headline: Santa Clara’s Finest went to work at 4:29 AM
lead.dek: Three moves in three minutes, every hole filled, a 16.0-point Thursday head start. The bubble leader did everything it could before sunrise. It is still a 36.2% underdog to 8-2 Poochinski.
lead.pull: The Finest have done their homework. Now they need the 8-2 team to leave a little of its own undone.
body: The timestamps tell the story. At 4:29 AM Saturday, Santa Clara’s Finest added Rome Odunze and dropped RJ Harvey, who is on IR. At 4:30 AM they cut Jeremiyah Love, also on IR. At 4:31 AM they added Ryan Flournoy. Three minutes, two dead roster spots cleared, two live receivers in. That is not a waiver run. That is a pit stop.

And it finished yesterday’s developing story. Blake Corum is on bye, and the call at running back went to Cam Skattebo (16.81), who slid over from FLEX. Denzel Boston is on bye, and Odunze (11.37) went straight into his WR slot. Bhayshul Tuten (15.49) carries no injury tag today. The one piece of bad news: Kenneth Walker III went from Questionable to Out with the groin, which is exactly why the shuffle had to happen.

The result is a lineup with no open questions. The Finest are set at 159.67, which is also their best possible lineup, with 16.0 already banked from Thursday’s Houston Texans D/ST (15.0) and Spencer Shrader (1.0). Joe Burrow (25.77) and Bryce Young (18.31) start at quarterback. Flournoy (10.23) sits on the bench as insurance.

Here’s the problem. Poochinski, as set, projects for just 154.15, and it is still a 63.8% favorite. That’s because its best lineup is 173.04: Jadarian Price and the Seattle Seahawks D/ST are both on bye, Luther Burden III (15.33) is waiting on the bench to replace Price by Sun 10:00 AM, and Caleb Williams (20.35) sits behind Aaron Rodgers (16.79). The 8-2 team has two open calls and a defense to find. The Finest have none left.

The stakes: Santa Clara’s Finest are 3-7 and 57.1% to take the last playoff spot, ahead of Maye I touch your TDs? (25.2%) and Big Stric Energy (17.7%). A win over the best team in the league would be the biggest result of their season. My read: Poochinski probably makes its calls and wins. But this is the upset I’d pick if I had to pick one, and the Finest have made it as easy as they can for that to happen.

quick_hits.headline: Thursday’s damage, banked
quick_hits.body: Four teams have points on the board. Bad things man bad things leads Cherry Blossom 21.46 to 0.0 on C.J. Stroud. Santa Clara’s Finest lead Poochinski 16.0 to 0.0. Big Stric Energy leads the champ 14.8 to 0.0 on Nico Collins. deeboliciouskins got only 9.9 from Jonathan Taylor (6.7) and Tyler Warren (3.2), and is still a 91.9% favorite.

quick_hits.headline: The 8-2 team is the underdog
quick_hits.body: Bad things man bad things is 8-2, up 21.46 to 0.0, and fully set: Jordyn Tyson carries no injury tag today. It’s still only 34.5% against 5-5 Cherry Blossom, because Cherry Blossom’s best lineup is 165.58 to Bad things’ 148.91. Cherry Blossom’s whole case runs through its bench: Jonah Coleman (17.21) and Bo Nix (17.83).

quick_hits.headline: Geno is in. Now find a tight end.
quick_hits.body: Big Stric Energy made the biggest call in the league: Geno Smith (16.18) in for Jordan Love, and Smith’s injury tag is gone. The new problem is Dalton Kincaid, now Doubtful with the thumb, with Tucker Kraft on bye and no healthy tight end behind him. Brenton Strange (9.11) is free. Saquon Barkley (12.91) also sits behind Braelon Allen (9.01).

quick_hits.headline: Two teams, two kickers on the wire
quick_hits.body: The champ’s Matt Gay is still Questionable with a hip and being dropped 61,065 times. deeboliciouskins still lists Jason Myers, who is on bye. Cairo Santos (6.56) has been added 83,657 times; Chase McLaughlin (6.41) is the other option. One each.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 is 7-3, safe, and short a quarterback
quick_hits.body: As set, AB81 projects for 67.33 against deeboliciouskins. Filling the holes gets it to 105.75 and an 8.1% shot. Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out and Jalen Hurts is on IR, so the second QB has to come off the wire, as does a FLEX for Rhamondre Stevenson. The good news: AB81’s playoff odds are already 100%, and its +2.7 luck is the best in the league.

quick_hits.headline: The Lions are still free
quick_hits.body: Poochinski still lists the Seattle Seahawks D/ST, which is on bye, and has no other defense. The Detroit Lions D/ST (7.5) is unrostered in R.A.T.S. and has been added 108,963 times. Burden for Price is due by Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-m1.headline: Matchup of the week: the 2-8 bowl
w11-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy leads the champ 14.8 to 0.0, made its QB call, and projects 153.54 to 147.47: a 56.1% favorite. Yesterday I took the champ. I’m flipping. Big Stric answered its biggest question; the champ is still waiting on a kicker’s hip.

w11-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins needs only a kicker
w11-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins is set at 175.02 and 91.9% to win. AB81’s best is 105.75, and getting there takes a quarterback and a FLEX from the wire.

w11-m3.headline: Bad things leads, Cherry Blossom favored
w11-m3.blurb: Bad things man bad things is up 21.46 to 0.0 and done setting its lineup. Cherry Blossom is 65.5% because its best is 165.58. Coleman, Nix and Brock Bowers’ ankle decide how close it gets.

w11-m4.headline: The Finest are finished. Poochinski isn’t.
w11-m4.blurb: Santa Clara’s Finest lead 16.0 to 0.0 and are set at 159.67. Poochinski is 154.15 as set, 173.04 at best, and 63.8% to win. The upset of the weekend if it happens.

w11-r7-s2.headline: Resolved: Skattebo slides to RB
w11-r7-s2.blurb: Blake Corum is on bye and Kenneth Walker III is Out. Santa Clara’s Finest moved Cam Skattebo (16.81) into the RB slot.

w11-r7-s4.headline: Resolved: Odunze in for Boston
w11-r7-s4.blurb: Denzel Boston is on bye. Rome Odunze (11.37), added at 4:29 AM, went straight into the WR slot.

w11-r1-s1.headline: Resolved: Geno Smith at QB
w11-r1-s1.blurb: Jordan Love is on bye. Big Stric Energy started Geno Smith (16.18), whose injury tag has cleared. The season-defining call, made.

w11-r1-s6.headline: What will Big Stric do at tight end?
w11-r1-s6.blurb: Dalton Kincaid (9.5) is now Doubtful with the thumb, and Tucker Kraft is on bye. Nobody is behind them. Brenton Strange (9.11) is on the wire and trending, added 53,181 times. I’d make the move today.

w11-r3-s9.headline: The champ’s kicker question, day two
w11-r3-s9.blurb: Matt Gay (6.47) is still Questionable with a hip. Cairo Santos (6.56) projects higher and is free. The champ is a 43.9% underdog. Take the certainty.

w11-r6-s9.headline: deeboliciouskins needs a kicker
w11-r6-s9.blurb: Jason Myers is on bye. Cairo Santos (6.56) or Chase McLaughlin (6.41). The only thing between this lineup and its 175.02.

w11-r8-s1.headline: Where does AB81 find a quarterback?
w11-r8-s1.blurb: Matthew Stafford is on bye, Sam Darnold is Out, Jalen Hurts is on IR. The bench has no answer, so the second QB comes from the wire.

w11-r8-s6.headline: Kittle over Andrews
w11-r8-s6.blurb: George Kittle (12.52) is on the bench behind Mark Andrews (7.4). The easiest 5 points on the board. Deadline Sun 5:20 PM.

w11-r4-s7.headline: Bowers or Coleman?
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Brock Bowers (14.62) is Questionable with an ankle. Jonah Coleman (17.21) projects higher anyway. Deadline Sun 1:25 PM.

w11-r2-s8.headline: Burden for Price
w11-r2-s8.blurb: Jadarian Price is on bye. Luther Burden III (15.33) is the obvious answer, and it’s due early: Sun 10:00 AM.

w11-r2-s10.headline: Poochinski needs a defense
w11-r2-s10.blurb: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST is on bye and there’s no backup. The Detroit Lions D/ST (7.5) is free.
